subject: Rmarkdown not working with fresh Rshiny installation AWS Ubuntu - Proxy issues?

messages.author: 52d927ea62ed5d01
messages.subject: Rmarkdown not working with fresh Rshiny installation AWS Ubuntu - Proxy issues?
parts:
Hello,

I'm having the somewhat famous issue associated with fresh installations of Rshiny on Ubuntu. On the homepage the rmarkdown example on the bottom does not appear.




First I would like to say I have looked at similar questions posted in this group including: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/shiny-discuss/cn1Mun-4b7I/l-Qc45KwAwcJ and https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/shiny-discuss/cn1Mun-4b7I/aL1K-EZ23XgJ specifically.

I'm operating behind a corporate proxy and have updated the /usr/lib/R/etc/Renviron.site to include the http_proxy and http_proxy_user variables.

Oddly enough, I can install other packages by going into "sudo R", then "install.packages('rmarkdown')... and this works for every package, except, rmarkdown.. which gives me a proxy error at the very end (this also fails if I do install.packages('rmarkdown', dependencies=TRUE)


Can anyone advise a potential solution? have I incorrectly updated my proxy settings? or have I failed to download a necessary library on the system(ubuntu)?

Cheers, 
Uros

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Rmarkdown not working with fresh Rshiny installation AWS Ubuntu - Proxy issues?
parts: It looks like the problem is with the stringi installation, which downloads some files from other websites. See the question and this answer on stack overflow for a workaround: http://stackoverflow.com/a/28530498/139922 Basically you manually download the icudt551.zip file from the URL in the error log, and put the file in a directory, then pass that directory as ICUDT_DIR.
